angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 880,756 km at 80.60 pc = 0.15 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 12.4074 +/- 0.0142 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93): 80.60 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.266 +/- 0.0235 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 332231 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 880,756 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.1642 +/- 0.0317 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 332231 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6128 +/- 87 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 332231 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 332231 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-332231.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.299, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 332231 (pscomppars): spectral type F8, from Dalba et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..241D/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 332231: main object type MS*, Main Sequence Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 332231 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.043 dex, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 332231 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.30792, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 332231 (pscomppars): age 2.9 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, HD 332231: projected rotation speed 5.2 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2025A&A...697A.102T)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
